requirement.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: sewage discharge and distance/ice-concentration properties
requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF sewage_discharge_type = not_comminuted_or_disinfected, THEN MARPOL_IV_11_1_1_compliance_status = compliant AND distance_to_nearest_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm > 12; record distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1.
requirement.requiredInputs: Discharge type, MARPOL compliance, position, and ice-condition data
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The ship is discharging sewage that is not comminuted or disinfected in accordance with regulation 11.1.1 of MARPOL Annex IV and at a distance of more than 12 nautical miles from any ice-shelf or fast ice and shall be as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10.
